description: The G2 status line 'REC 00:12  Speaker' is too big. While recording, a dot blinks in its own small top-right container; the timer leaves the glasses (the phone keeps it). Paused shows PAUSED on the left. Consent text and plan.md say the glasses show a blinking dot instead of REC.

comments.text: Follow-up: recording/paused pages drop the status container; body is 0,0 528x288 beside the dot (overlap avoided: firmware z-order unverified).

Dot is '•', on 5 s / off 0.4 s. Couldn't find how Conversate draws its pulsing dot (native, undocumented). SDK 0.0.15 has textColor 0-4 on text upgrades, so a brightness pulse is possible later (~3 upgrades/s); image flipbooks manage ~9 fps at 30x30.

title: Glasses recording indicator: a small blinking dot in the top-right corner instead of REC and the timer
